Claim amendment · `domain:engine` seat 2 (seat post #20966) · `os-bill` · `session_01FaVyM6YvQLg9CsjPVCYc5K` · 2026-10-22T21:45Z · to claim 6351990387.

**File surface widened by one consumer line:** `packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-connection-plugin.ts:316` (`domain:cli` lane) calls the new `@objectstack/core` predicate instead of deriving "control plane bound" inline. Reason: cloud-connection depends on core, so the fuse in core cannot read cloud-connection's `platformManaged`; the one source of the fact moves to core (`resolveControlPlaneApiKey(configured?)` beside `isCloudManaged()` in `stack-auth.ts`) and cloud-connection reads it — one derivation, as ruling 6341690661 Q2 → D requires. The card thread posts the cross-lane declaration the lane table requires; ⛔ not a claim on any `domain:cli` card.

**Accepted shape (seat's ruling on the thread's measurement):** the fuse reads the environment branch (`OS_CLOUD_API_KEY`), which cloud-connection documents as "injected by the cloud into the runtimes it hosts"; in-repo, no production construction passes `controlPlaneApiKey` by config. A production boot binding the control plane by plugin config alone while setting `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1` is refused — the loud, safe direction — and the PR body names it. The fuse fires at `isCloudManaged()`'s first read and at `ObjectKernel.bootstrap()`, memoized, with `resetCloudManagedForTesting()` exported for the services half's tests. "Production" reuses `isDevelopmentBoot()` (`stack-auth.ts:135`).

`@objectstack/core` now exports `isCloudManaged()` as the only reader of `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED`, plus `resolveControlPlaneApiKey()` and `resetCloudManagedForTesting()`. The production fuse runs at first read and at boot in both `ObjectKernel` and `LiteKernel`, and cloud-connection reads the core predicate. This unblocks #25083's services half and the joint spec PR #25309 (`Blocked-by: #25294`). One item stays open with the maintainer: confirm the cloud injects `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY` as an environment variable before the next pin move. State: `pm:dispatched` removed in this act.

Cloud reading for the open item in the landing comment ("confirm the cloud injects `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY` as an environment variable before the next pin move"). Measured 2026-10-23, read-only: secret names and redacted boot snapshots only, no value read.

| Probe | Production (`objectos` Worker) | Staging (`objectos-staging` Worker) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY` on the Worker | secret, set | secret, set |
| Forwarded into the container | yes: `FORWARDED_ENV_KEYS`, cloud `apps/objectos/cloudflare/worker.ts:283` | same code |
| Inside the container at boot (`[objectos config]` snapshot, last 24 h) | `set(len=64)` on 19 of 19 boots | `set(len=64)` on 12 of 12 boots |
| `NODE_ENV` | `production` | `production` |
| `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED` | exactly `1` (default in `ObjectOSContainer.envVars`) | exactly `1` |

So the fuse is armed on both hosted planes, and it passes: the next cloud pin move past `db1c7ccad` does not take the hosted containers down. The open question in the dev report (refusing a non-`1`, non-empty value) does not reach cloud, which sets exactly `1`. Cloud's control plane and the self-hosted images never set `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED`. The cloud pin in flight (objectstack-ai/cloud#3150, `b6e87070`) is 66 commits behind `db1c7ccad`, so the accessor and its fuse first reach cloud in the next pin move. The same reading is recorded on objectstack-ai/cloud#3169.
